versions.description_html:
Learn how Azure Managed Identities eliminate hardcoded secrets in your cloud apps. Discover system and user-assigned types, token flow, and best practices.

Your Azure app probably has a password written into its settings right now. Every database login, API key, and secret copied into a config file is a key left out in the open, and millions of them leak every year.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • Why Secrets in Code Are a Problem
  • What a Managed Identity Actually Is
  • System-Assigned and User-Assigned
  • How Your App Gets a Token
  • Granting Access with Role Assignments
  • Reaching Key Vault Without a Password
  • Where Managed Identities Work
  • The Pitfalls to Watch For
  • A Quick Recap and One Question

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
